title: Ukuba Wedwa Phantsi Kwesundu Elikude
intro: Khawucinge ngokuzifihla okuzolileyo kude nezihlwele eziqhelekileyo, apho ukuzinikela kudibana nomyalelo ongaqhelekanga. Isicaka esisodwa siyarhoxa ngobunyulu nokuthemba, sixhaswa yilungiselelo elingabonakaliyo. Kujikeleze lo mphefumlo kukho imiqondiso ephikisana nengcaciso eqhelekileyo, ngelixa ukubhuda kwamathandabuzo kulinda ngaphaya kwendawo yokuzifihla. Sondela uze umamele, kuba inyaniso apha iya kuyichasa yonke into ecingelwayo.
clues: Ndizinikele ekunquleni ndedwa, ndixhaswa yilungiselelo leNkosi yam.
Ndifumene iindaba ezimnandi zokuba uAllah undikhethile ngaphezu kwabo bonke abafazi behlabathi.
Ndarhoxa ndaya kwindawo ekude empuma, ndizigqumile ebantwini basekhaya, xa umoya wabonakala kum ungumntu ogqibeleleyo.
Ndakhulelwa umntwana ngelizwi lika-Allah nangona kungekho mntu wakha wandichukumisa.
Ndanyamezela umsebenzi ndedwa phantsi komthi wesundu ndaza ndeva ilizwi lindithuthuzela ngomlambo phantsi kwam kunye needethi ezintsha zokutya nokusela.
Ndabuyela ebantwini bam ndithwele usana lwam olusandul’ ukuzalwa, ndafunga ukuba ndithule, kwaye usana lwam lwathetha kwasebuntwaneni ukundikhusela njengomkhonzi ka-Allah.
